title: Natural and man-made materials
misconception: 1C-M1: thinks shaping a natural material makes it man-made
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: Natural materials come from plants, animals or the ground.
Wood and cotton come from plants. Wool comes from animals. Clay comes from the ground.
Man-made materials are made by people changing natural materials.
Plastic, glass and cement are man-made.
A carpenter cuts wood to make a stool. The stool is still made of wood.
Cutting or shaping does not change the material. Wood is still a natural material.
A cotton shirt is sewn by people, but cotton is still a natural material.
Now it is your turn. Ask where the material came from.
